name: After § 26
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 26a. Underlines the need to prioritise adaptation actions over mitigation within the EU and globally, to minimise the negative effects of climate change on people and in relation to biodiversity loss while respecting differentiated responsibilities and respective capabilities, in the light of different national and regional circumstances;
